summary: Bug fix validation — 'Boutons figés' (frozen action buttons). Tested on the live Expo web preview (390x844) against the seeded COOPTEST / Patron Diomandé Mamadou / 0700000001 / PIN 1234 account. ALL SCENARIOS PASS. (1) 'Se connecter' (coop) with wrong PIN '9999' → red error 'Code secret incorrect.' appears and the button is immediately re-enabled (no residual 'Veuillez patienter…'). (2) With correct PIN '1234', tapping 'Se connecter' shows the ActivityIndicator + 'Veuillez patienter…' label briefly (verified visible ~80 ms after tap) and then navigates to the Patron dashboard — screen title 'Diomande Mamadou / Patron / Acheteur' visible. (3) Navigation testID='nav-planteurs' tap → planteurs list opens (member row 'Kouassi Yao Test' PL-2026-0001 present). (4) Modifier flow: tapped testID='member-edit' → sheet 'Modifier le planteur' opens with all fields pre-filled (village input = 'Sikensi' verified), changed to 'Sikensi Modif', tapped Enregistrer (SaveBtn testID='save-btn') → sheet closes, modification persists on the detail card ('Sikensi Modif' visible). Reverted afterwards to 'Sikensi' to keep state clean. (5) Réinitialiser le code secret: tapped testID='member-resetpin' → sub-sheet with two '••••' inputs opens, entered '5678' twice, tapped 'Enregistrer le nouveau code' → SaveBtn completes (busy state clears within ~3 s), success notice testID='notice-ok' displayed. Restored PIN back to '1234'. (6) Anti double-clic verified indirectly: the SaveBtn wrapper (ui.tsx lines 90-115) locally sets busy=true, disables the Pressable and replaces the label with 'Veuillez patienter…' until the awaited onPress promise resolves — pressing again while busy is a no-op. (7) No red screen, no JS console errors, no MOCKED APIs.
action_items: None — bug 'boutons figés' is fixed. SaveBtn correctly yields to UI (yieldToUI 16 ms), shows ActivityIndicator + 'Veuillez patienter…', debounces re-taps via the local busy flag, and always resets busy in the finally block (with a mounted ref guard for unmount safety). Login handlers doCoopLogin/doPlanteurLogin are async and awaited via SaveBtn's onPress promise-wrapper — verifyPinAsync yields before PBKDF2 so the indicator paints before the 15 000-iteration hash runs. Safe to ship.
critical_code_review_comments: ui.tsx SaveBtn (l. 75-115): correct async wrapping — onPress can return void or Promise; Promise.resolve() normalises, try/finally always resets busy. Uses React.useRef mounted flag to avoid setState after unmount. testID='save-btn' present.

pin.ts: ITERATIONS reduced from 100 000 to 15 000 with a comment justifying the trade-off for a 4-digit PIN (only 10 000 combinations). yieldToUI (setTimeout 16 ms) before pbkdf2 lets the UI paint the loading state — this is what actually fixes the freeze. verifyPinAsync (l. 65-68) also yields before verifyPin, so login handlers no longer block the UI thread.

auth.tsx Login: doCoopLogin/doPlanteurLogin are now async and awaited by SaveBtn; if s.pin is present, `await verifyPinAsync(...)` runs off-frame. Wrong PIN branch sets an error string and returns — SaveBtn's finally resets busy → button re-enabled immediately (verified live).

index.tsx confirm modal (l. 306-322): 'Annuler' testID='confirm-cancel' and yes button testID='confirm-yes' rendered as plain Pressable (not SaveBtn) with static labels — action is synchronous (settleMemberDue / delete) so a busy indicator is unnecessary; still, no risk of freeze because handler is O(n) over collections.

sheets.tsx MemberSheet .save() calls createPinRecord which is async — SaveBtn awaits it, so the 15k-iteration pbkdf2 runs after the loader is painted. Verified live for both Modifier and Réinitialiser le code secret.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 scenarios: login-wrong-PIN, login-success-with-busy, nav, modifier-open, modifier-save-persist, resetpin-completes, resetpin-notice)

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the original freeze: the previous 100 000-iteration PBKDF2 ran synchronously in the JS thread before React could commit the disabled/busy state — the button appeared frozen for ~1-2 s on entry-level phones and the touch event was dropped silently. Fix applied by main agent (verified): (a) reduced iterations to 15 000, appropriate for a 4-digit PIN with only 10 000 possible values, (b) exported an async verifyPinAsync that awaits a yieldToUI() (setTimeout 16 ms) so React paints the busy state before starting the hash, (c) createPinRecord is also async and yields, (d) SaveBtn locally tracks busy, shows ActivityIndicator + 'Veuillez patienter…', disables re-taps, and always resets busy in a try/finally (with a mounted ref to avoid setState after unmount), (e) both doCoopLogin and doPlanteurLogin are now async so SaveBtn awaits them. Mitigation validated live: wrong-PIN, correct-login, Modifier save, ResetPin save all complete cleanly with no residual busy state and no double-submit.
